scope: Two targeted primary sources with exact-version PDFs and rendered pages; not an exhaustive novelty search.

papers.title: Multivariate Confidence Calibration for Object Detection
papers.review: Abstract, introduction and rendered PDF page4 read. Independent and dependent logistic/beta calibration condition on confidence and box geometry; dependence modeling is established.
papers.overlap_and_limit: Additional geometric variables and multivariate calibration are prior work. This screen uses predicted-region-excluded scene response summaries, not a reproduction or proof of a new method.

zotero.readback: Four authors, exact-version URL, date and collection confirmed; attachment filename and application/pdf imported_file confirmed.

papers.title: On Calibration of Object Detectors: Pitfalls, Evaluation and Baselines
papers.review: Abstract, introduction and rendered PDF page5 read. The paper separates accuracy and calibration, shows binary TP/FP calibration can miss localization quality, and emphasizes properly designed calibration data and cheap post-hoc baselines.
papers.overlap_and_limit: Cheap post-hoc fitting is an established strong baseline. Candidate55 NLL/AUROC is a fixed-query binary diagnostic, not detection AP, localization-aware calibration or proof of deployment utility.

zotero.readback: Four authors, exact-version URL, date and collection confirmed; attachment filename and application/pdf imported_file confirmed.

collection_work: Exact-version PDFs downloaded through Paper Search, parsed and locally extracted. Both PDFs attached to existing Zotero parents and children read back. Incremental semantic update:2 added,0 errors.
search_boundary: An initial broad detector-calibration query returned irrelevant physics papers. Corrected cs.CV query located these papers. Other returned metadata was not treated as read or downloaded evidence. No absence-of-prior-work claim.
candidate_result: Masked background summaries fail row and whole-scene controls, tiny AUROC, paired interval and all-size protection. STOP; no detector training or AP trial authorized.
